notes.title: LOGistICAL 1 Build #820
notes.content:
This update incorporates all the fixes that have been made while the last few LOGistICAL 2 (L2) modules have been built and rolled out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27575556/eec41c948a3fcc1f6a8dd2646db58d255f4a9e06.png[/img]
Major changes that have happened in the LOGistICAL world include:
- the release of LOGistICAL 2: Vampires as a DLC of LOGistICAL 2
- the release of LOGistICAL 2: Texas as a DLC of LOGistICAL 2
- the release of LOGistICAL 2: Indonesia as a DLC of LOGistICAL 2
- LOGistICAL 2 is now FREE to play

Each of these LOGistICAL 2 DLCs have a FREE to play sub-module. There is then the option to purchase in-game or buy the bundle through Steam at a discounted price.

[h1]Quality of Life Updates[/h1]
A short list of little updates that will make playing that little bit nicer.

- Added the Skip button to the truck list
- Put the Skip button in the middle of the truck dash when industry runs out of output- Green quarantine for not full quarantines
- A more simple (nicer looking) mouse over town popup
- Removal of building icons over the map
- Fixed a routing problem (teleportation) where the first truck isn't at source but second truck is.

Most of the other updates are back end modifications making things run smoother and faster.
